mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: it showed oxygen attaching and then being released near tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding red cells to plasma felt mostly like an assembly step; it showed where they sit but added little beyond the stated goal.

surprise.text: I was surprised that mature red blood cells have no nuclei.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although adding white cells and platelets was mostly following the remaining outline; their individual jobs were not explained in detail.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how blood connects to other body systems, though the assembly steps were fairly predictable.
